study type: Cross-sectional study (retrospective review of medical registry data)
exposure: Placenta previa in the third trimester
outcome: Admission to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit
cohort: The study included 159 pregnant women with a uterine scar and placenta previa in the third trimester, identified from medical birth registry data between 2011 and 2022.
finding: The study found substantial maternal and fetal risks associated with placenta previa in the presence of a uterine scar during the third trimester, with observed rates including 7.5% postpartum hemorrhage, 15.7% antepartum hemorrhage, 30.2% blood transfusion, and 42.8% prematurity.
mod_finding: The majority of women in the study underwent a caesarean section for delivery.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical birth registry data between 2011 and 2022.
